paper_id: Enjoy your observability_ an industrial survey of microservice tracing and analysis
title: Enjoy your observability: an industrial survey of microservice tracing and analysis
motivation: 分布式追踪是否能满足工业微服务的可观测性需求尚不明确
problem_framing: 通过访谈十家公司开发者与运维工程师,调查追踪分析实践
key_insight: 微服务追踪分析是软件工程的新大数据问题,智能分析仍处于起步阶段
method_signature: 25位受访者来自10家公司5个领域,定性访谈+开放编码分析
evaluation_criteria: 基于访谈发现归纳实践模式、权衡考量与挑战
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 机器学习与数据挖掘等高级分析技术很少使用,智能追踪分析仍处于起步阶段
evidence_for_taste: while more advanced analysis techniques such as machine learning and data mining are seldom used
microservice tracing and analysis is a new big data problem for software engineering
the implementations of the pipeline in different companies reflect different tradeoffs
the quality of the trace data, the lack of trace data annotation, and the ever-changing nature
thinking_moves: 从行业实践归纳通用模式而非提出新算法
识别技术采纳中的权衡而非单纯列举工具
把定性访谈结果结构化为pipeline模型
承认高级技术落地与现实的差距
